name: taskflow
description: TaskFlow - aplicación de tareas con tablero Kanban y dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @taskflow/api" "npm run dev -w @taskflow/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:test:prepare -w @taskflow/api && npm run test -w @taskflow/e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
